name: Galvanized Horn
summary: In the Charred Vale, chimaera matriarchs bear horns that Stormwind and Thunder Bluff armorers seek. These hardened growths go into specialized armor for warriors.

sections.title: Trophy of the Charred Vale
sections.body: Chimaera matriarchs prowl the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. Their horns grow unusually hard through ash, flame, and survival. Lesser fledgling chimaeras yield brittle, blackened horns, but a matriarch's horn has strength like treated metal. Furen Longbeard in Stormwind and Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff both seek one as a test of martial valor and a key ingredient for exceptional mail armor.

faq.q: Where does a Galvanized Horn come from?
faq.answer: A Galvanized Horn comes from a chimaera matriarch in the Charred Vale, in the western Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why do smiths want this specific horn?
faq.answer: Master armorers prize the horn's density and heat resistance. They use it to reinforce specialized suits of mail and plate armor.

Furen Longbeard in Stormwind seeks the horn for fire-hardened armor for Alliance warriors. Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff seeks it as proof of strength and to fashion a warrior's helm for Horde warriors.

faq.q: How does it differ from a regular Charred Horn?
aliases: is it different from charred horn
faq.answer: Common Charred Horns come from lesser, fledgling chimaeras. A Galvanized Horn comes from a mature matriarch and has a denser, tempered structure suited to masterwork smithing.

angles.text: As a warrior, slaying a matriarch and securing her Galvanized Horn tests your endurance and power. It proves your mettle to master armorers in Stormwind or Thunder Bluff.
As a blacksmith, the horn shows how organic materials hardened in extreme conditions can match or exceed worked metals in custom armor reinforcement.
